tools.name: find_local_businesses
tools.description: Businesses listed on Google Maps for 1-5 categories in an area (city, postal code, country, or coordinates with a radius), with optional lead filters: no website, unclaimed profile, rating below a value, fewer reviews than a value, or first listed in the last N days. Returns name, category, address,

tools.name: business_reviews
tools.description: Recent reviews of 1-5 businesses from Google Maps, Trustpilot or Tripadvisor: rating, title, text (first 600 characters), date, language and the owner's reply, plus rating stats and a monthly trend per business. Reviewer names, profiles and photos are never returned. Billed per review returned plus

tools.name: review_summary
tools.description: Analyses the recent reviews of 1-3 businesses (Google Maps, Trustpilot or Tripadvisor) and returns per business: a short summary, up to 8 complaint themes and 6 praise themes with mention counts, share and short example excerpts, suggested actions, rating distribution, monthly trend and owner reply

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Fetch the results of a find_local_businesses, business_reviews or review_summary call that returned a run_id because it took longer than about two minutes. Returns the status while it is still running. Free: the original run is billed.
